script_temoin_ancien:
import hashlib,json,warnings
from pathlib import Path
from vinkulum import Noyau,_vinkulum
n=Noyau([0.,0.,0.])
n.corps('libre',1.,[1.,0.,0.,0.,1.,0.,0.,0.,1.],[0.,0.,0.])
n.effort(0,[5e-7,0.,0.],[0.,0.,0.])
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
 warnings.simplefilter('always')
 result=n.statique(tol=1e-12,iters=12,paliers_max=1)
print(json.dumps({'extension_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(_vinkulum.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'retour':result,'avertissements':[str(w.message) for w in caught],
 'residu_libre':max(map(abs,n.residu_statique()))}))
